title: giPlayer-ext
body: After 15 years since I did any work on it, I've just released an updated, tested and working version of giPlayer-ext, a fork of Robbie C Smith's original giPlayer frontend for get_iplayer , which introduces streaming of IPlayer TV and Radio, with a clean, modern interface. It's a small python script, and you can find it at https://sourceforge.net/projects/giplayerext/ If anyone would prefer an AUR package, let me know.
